description: This file contains functions and classes for parsing the output of 'am instrument' commands on Android devices, including extracting test results and instrumentation finish bundles.

classes.name: TestResult
classes.description: Represents a single test result with methods to access test name, status code, failure reason, and result fields.

methods.name: ParseAmInstrumentOutput
methods.description: Parses raw output of 'am instrument' command into structured test results and finish bundle.

methods.name: _ParseInstrumentationFinishedBundle
methods.description: Extracts key/value pairs from 'am instrument' output representing the finish bundle.
